notes: Sorrir is the intransitive verb 'to smile'. If you want to say someone is smiling at someone or something, use the preposition 'para': 'Ela sorriu para ele' (She smiled at him).
Do not confuse this with 'rir', which means 'to laugh' (to make sounds). You can 'sorrir' without making any noise at all.

senses.definition: To make a happy face by curving the corners of the mouth.
To show kindness or favor towards someone, often figuratively.
